independence: Fresh rewrite, selector and answer calls for every case in each run; prior model output never added to history. Shared embeddings only. No tuning after opening.
guard: Retire split if outputs used for tuning. Never overwrite reports or modify gold after querying.

pipeline.route: Known Qwen provider timeouts: this evaluation exercises Large route only, not Qwen quality.
pipeline.chunks: same bounded app paragraph groups, 1800 UTF16/200 overlap for long groups
pipeline.query: original/history/selected text plus independently generated English query without answer facts
pipeline.ambiguity: rewrite flags unresolvable pronoun-only questions before candidates; deterministic no-source result, no selector/answer calls
pipeline.candidates: equal RRF60 original dense top40 + English dense top40 + English BM25 top40; retain top40; pin user quote
pipeline.selection: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash JSON, max8 sources, sourceBudget18000 UTF8 bytes
pipeline.answer: same model, max2 claims; fixed partial/not_found display notes; promptBudget28000 UTF8 bytes

licensing: Original public-domain-USA Gutenberg EPUBs retained with credits/licensing.
diagnostic: validation2 consumed; final candidate28/30 range proxy, conservative complete27/30;10/10 negatives. No further tuning before validation3.
replayAdaptation: #117 extends the shared OpenRouter transport; frozen spike evidence is archived byte-for-byte in replayOf. Gold, prompts and retrieval helpers unchanged. This replay manifest is not a new quality evaluation.
